messages:
Nina (Docs): Quick sync: we plan to publish the v1->v2 deprecation banner + migration guide Friday 9am PT. Need final i18n extraction and a CI smoke test for snippet parity.
Haruto (i18n): OK. Which files are considered canonical? The migration guide + /quickstart and the deprecation banner text?
Nina (Docs): Canonical: /content/deprecations/v1_to_v2/index.md, /guides/migration-v1-to-v2.md and all quickstart snippets under /examples/quickstart.
Bea (Localization): We'll pull strings from a single JSON export. Can you add a literal-only section for code blocks so we don't accidentally translate those?
Priya (SDK): Yes please. SDK examples should have a fenced block with `// DO_NOT_TRANSLATE: code` at the top. Also we need to standardize on ISO timestamps: use `2026-04-01T12:00:00Z` in examples.
Nina (Docs): Added an extraction rule in the PR: keys starting with `code_` are marked literal. File path in PR: /content/deprecations/v1_to_v2/strings.json.
Haruto (i18n): I'll run the linter to ensure no month-first dates. Regex: `\\b(0?[1-9]|1[0-2])\\/(0?[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])\\/\\d{4}\\b`. I'll attach results to the PR checks.
Bea (Localization): Also request: keep placeholders as tokens like `{DEPRECATION_DATE}` and `{MODEL_ALIAS}`. We'll translate around them.
Priya (SDK): One more SDK note: model aliasing line in examples should be `model: \"rwd-text-2\" // subject to aliasing during sunset`. Please ensure the comment is in English only.
Nina (Docs): For screenshots: replace with text snippets. We can't create per-locale screenshots for this release. We'll add a follow-up issue to revisit.
DevRel Bot: Created issue #876: \"locale-specific screenshots for deprecation guide\".
Bea (Localization): Timeline: once English PR merges, we'll create language branches automatically via the i18n pipeline. Expect ~3 business days for FR/DE, 4 for JA/KO.
Haruto (i18n): Also adding a smoke test: after deploy, a small Cypress test will check that the banner displays and that the `{DEPRECATION_DATE}` token is replaced server-side. I can add it to the docs CI pipeline.
Priya (SDK): Will open a companion PR to normalize snippets across SDKs. I'll reference the docs PR and add test snippets in the test-suite that compare generated HTML output for parity.
Nina (Docs): PR title: \"docs: i18n extract + snippet literals for v1->v2 deprecation\". Tagging legal for the deprecation timeline copy.
Bea (Localization): Minor request: add a `short_banner` key (max 140 chars) and `long_banner` for full page. We need both for tight headers vs. announcement page.
Nina (Docs): Done. Strings added: `short_banner`, `long_banner`, `migration_step_X`, `note_model_alias`, `code_example_js_quickstart`.
Haruto (i18n): Running pre-merge checks now. Found one leftover MM/DD/YYYY in examples/old_quickstart.md line 12. Marked as fix in PR.
Priya (SDK): I'll update JS/Python/Go snippets and ensure comments follow `// DO_NOT_TRANSLATE` pattern.
Nina (Docs): Final checklist: English PR merged -> i18n pipeline creates branches -> localization teams submit PRs -> CI checks run -> we merge localized branches -> deploy Friday 9am PT. If any blockers, roll back banner and configs.
Bea (Localization): Acknowledged. We'll prioritize DE/FR for back-translation.
DevRel Bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1288 \".
